topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: When you told me you're moving across the country, my first thought was how much everything will change. But my second thought was about you, and how exciting this new chapter must be for you. I want you to chase your dreams, even if it means less coffee dates and spontaneous adventures. I'll miss our late-night talks, but I know we'll find new ways to share the big and small moments. This might be the start of a new journey for both of us, and I'm here to support you every step of the way, no matter the distance. Let's promise to make this transition smoother, together.
